sentence: Antivirals that act against herpes viruses, including aciclovir and valaciclovir.
note: NHS names valaciclovir as similar to aciclovir; MedlinePlus: antivirals

sentence: They are used for cold sores, shingles, chickenpox and genital herpes.
Aciclovir is described by MedlinePlus as a synthetic nucleoside analogue antiviral that works by stopping the spread of the virus in the body.
The NHS says this stops the herpes virus multiplying and spreading, but the virus is not removed from the body completely.
Allergy to aciclovir or valaciclovir is a reason to tell a doctor before use.
Kidney problems and older age may lead the prescriber to adjust treatment.
The NHS says these may not mix well with some types of aciclovir tablets.
A serious allergic reaction is rare; swelling of the lips, mouth, throat or tongue, or difficulty breathing, needs a 999 call.

note: valaciclovir named as similar medicine by NHS
